notes.title: Carrier Deck version 1.1.2 is out!
notes.content:
[b]Carrier Deck[/b] has been updated to [b]version 1.1.2![/b] 
This update brings a lot of improvements and changes, making the game better than ever! Now, [b]you can launch missions in any order[/b] (you do not have to do them in the order of the mission queue). As a balancing act to that, the mission queue has been reduced to 3 slots. 

Check the entire changelog below!


[b]Version 1.1.2 Patchnotes[/b]

•Improved feedback for invalid launches
•Improved mission launching mechanism where missions can be launched without needing to select units
•Changed cargo missions to immediately add Logistics mission on landing
•Missions no longer have to be launched in their order in the mission queue
•Reduced number of slots in the mission queue to 3
•Missions in queue show chevrons when the mission is ready to launch
•Aircraft can turn around on elevators
•Removed unnecessary loadout options from loadout radial on Greyhound, Hawkeye and Osprey
•Improved damage effects on units
•Changed Abort Mission behaviour to be a once off deferral rather than ditching the aircraft and launching a rescue mission
•Fixed mouse clicks not being recognised on some occasions
•Balanced survival Mode
•Fixed Achievements
•Fixed various landing bugs
•Fixed various mission queue bugs

notes.title: Carrier Deck Update to V1.1.1 on Open Beta !!
notes.content:
Improved feedback for invalid launches
Improved mission launching mechanism where missions can be launched without needing to select units
Changed cargo missions to immediately add Logistics mission on landing
Missions no longer have to be launched in their order in the mission queue
Reduced number of slots in the mission queue to 3
Missions in queue show chevrons when the mission is ready to launch
Aircraft can turn around on elevators
Removed unnecessary loadout options from loadout radial on Greyhound, Hawkeye and Osprey
Improved damage effects on units
Changed Abort Mission behaviour to be a once off deferral rather than ditching the aircraft and launching a rescue mission
Fixed mouse clicks not being recognised on some occasions

HOW TO UPDATE TO V1.1.1 Open Beta

In your Steam Library, right-click "Carrier Deck" and select “Properties.”
Select the “Betas” tab.
The Beta tag "Beta - Open Beta" will appear in the Beta dropdown list. Select it and close the Properties window.
Steam should now update "Carrier Deck" to the beta version. 

If the update does not start automatically, launch the game to force the update process or...
Select "Local Files" tab
Select "Verify Intergrity of Game Files"

notes.title: Carrier Deck patch to V1.0.2
notes.content:
- Added clear feedback when player attempting an invalid launch
- Reduced sensitivity of the click-and-hold radial menu
- Increased the amount of time a traffic jam has to get unstuck before returning 
  to previous positions
- Fixed South Pacific mission 01 failing after Carrier is hit once
- Fixed submarine bug in North Atlantic mission 04
- Stopped rescue missions jumping the mission queue
- Renamed Cancel button in camera presets to Deck for clarity
- Lt level in Quick and Survival game modes modified for a more 'paced' game
- Fixed Alt-Tabbing removing unit colors
- Reduced Bloom Effect on explosions

notes.title: The Flare Path: Flat Top Frenzy
notes.content: Johan Nagel’s latest creation feels like a ZX Spectrum title. One third management game, one third arcade game, and one third wargame, Carrier Deck [official site] reminds me of the sort of hectic homework-hinderer I used to play back in the days before manuals, monitors, and genres entered my life. If I mentally squint I can see 11-year-old me playing a 2D version on the family TV. My sister and me have just made a deal. The next time my carrier sustains damage, I’ll call it a night. F/A-18s will make way for the kids from Fame. … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Carrier Deck is released! Are you ready to take off?
notes.content:
Welcome on board Commander. Time is essential, so let me brief you on the situation. We have just released a challenging time management game, full of hazardous take-offs and perilous interceptions. Reports from preview twitch streams say that players will be constantly under pressure and to make things worse, there are high chances to lose all the pilots and planes in horrendous and avoidable incidents.

But now you are here!  The entire USS Ronald Reagan Carrier is at your command! Will you be successful in managing his deck?

The wait is finally over! [b]Carrier Deck[/b] is out now and it is ready to stun you!

www.youtube.com/watch?v=xCng_AAmb3w

You will play as the Air Officer on board a CVN-76 in the midst of an active war. You, alone, are responsible for all aspects of operations involving aircraft on the ship and you'll need to work fast to ensure everything happens on time for the highest chances of success!


Do you want to see some action? Follow us today as we stream the game on our official [url=https://www.twitch.tv/slitherinegroup]Twitch Channel[/url] at 11 am EST / 3 pm GMT / 5 pm CEST!

notes.title: Carrier Deck Refueling Tutorial
notes.content:
Welcome to the first lesson on how to manage an air fleet, captains!

Today, we will learn how to make sure our boys stay in the air for the entirety of their flight.

As the game is soon to be released, we deemed it appropriate to give you some tips for starting your captain's career.

In the video below, the first of a 3 part series, we show you how you can refuel your aircraft and prepare them for take off. 

 www.youtube.com/watch?v=2ChDVazsGWU

Stay tuned for more tips on how to manage the air fleet of the World's largest carrier!
